Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations

Class Migration

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.Migration
public abstract class Migration extends Object
One schema change, applied by up(Schema) and undone by down(Schema).

The name identifies the migration in the migrations table, so it must never change once the migration has run anywhere. Start it with the date, as Laravel's file names do, for example 2026_10_31_000000_create_users_table, so names sort in the order they were written.

Implementations should be stateless: the same instance may be run, rolled back and run again.

    • name

      public abstract String name()
      Returns the name recorded in the migrations table.
      Returns:
      the name, never null; non-blank, at most 191 characters, without control characters

    • up

      public abstract void up(Schema schema)
      Applies the change.
      Parameters:
      schema - the schema builder of the migration's connection, never null; bound to the migration's transaction when there is one. Run raw SQL through schema.connection(), never through a connection held elsewhere, or it runs outside that transaction.

    • down

      public void down(Schema schema)
      Undoes the change.
      Parameters:
      schema - the schema builder of the migration's connection, never null; bound to the migration's transaction when there is one
      Implementation Requirements:
      The default does nothing, like a Laravel migration without a down method.

    • checksum

      public Optional<String> checksum()
      Returns a checksum that detects an edit made after the migration ran.

      The migrator records it when the migration runs and compares it on later runs; a difference stops the run with a MigrationChecksumException. Return a fixed constant for this migration, set once, or a hash of a canonical description of the change through MigrationChecksum.of(String). The checksum detects an accidental edit of a migration that already ran; it is not a version, and a deployed migration is never edited, so its checksum never changes. The library never hashes the compiled class, because that differs between compilers and code shrinkers.

      Returns:
      the checksum, at most 64 characters, or empty for no check
      Implementation Requirements:
      The default returns an empty optional, which means the migration is not checked. The value must be stable between runs of the same code.
